notes.title: Escape Machines - Unreal engine switch coming soon - Super sale!
notes.content:
Escape Machines will soon be migrated over to the Unreal Engine, the game will have a major upgrade. So grab the game now for a massive bargain before the price goes up. 

Please follow game updates here, any feedback will be fed back to the developer. http://steamcommunity.com/app/363490/discussions/

Thanks guys, 

You rock!

notes.title: Escape Machines beta 0.3 is here!

Escape Machines beta has been updated to version 0.3
So, the game has been updated with additional content, level 3 and a boss fight.

Thanks for your support guys, please let us know what you think of level 3!
